common_processing: Decode public HQ MP3 with ffmpeg 7.1 to mono PCM16 WAV at 44100 Hz.
Smooth zero-phase frequency rolloffs: highpass 65 Hz (4th-power magnitude), lowpass 6500 Hz (4th-order Butterworth magnitude).
No synthetic noise, oscillator, campfire layer, or tonal magic layer added.

edits.FireFangIgnition.wav: Source 0.10–0.58 s; 8 ms raised-cosine attack, 115 ms raised-cosine release; peak 0.91.
edits.FireFangLoop.wav: Source 0.68–2.52 s; 200 ms complementary half-cosine overlap; subtract DC; peak 0.82; circular rotation 16689 frames to a smooth waveform boundary; duration 1.64 s.
edits.FireFangImpact.wav: Source 0.22–0.60 s; exponential amplitude taper exp(-2.1*t); 4 ms raised-cosine attack, 85 ms raised-cosine release; peak 0.91. Pure fire puff, no added crunch.

validation: PCM encoding, duration, channel count, finite samples, output peaks, clipping, and loop-boundary measurements verified from the saved WAV files. Auditory approval should be based on playback in the game.
